rule_or_requirement: A learned pixel-only speed adviser must preserve valid completion and shorten finished lap time against its exact pixel control.
observable_information: Rendered four-frame pixels, inherited pixel-driver action, student posterior, matched finish and lap traces.
allowed_action_or_state_change: On clear low-steer decisions, a frozen student with posterior at least 0.8 can raise gas to 0.28; steering, brake and obstacle protection remain inherited.
expected_success_endpoint: At least control valid completions, no candidate-only nonfinish or invalid action, activation, and at least 2% lower median finished lap time on jointly completed cells.
control: StableRiskEnvelopeAgent over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish, fewer finishes, invalid actions, no gas interventions, or less than 2% paired median lap improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve matched fresh TUNE cells on tracks 1–3 × seeds 5200–5203, twenty-four episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
